scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and russet mantle sits on a reed mat beside a low wooden table and rolled parchment. He looks upward toward an open doorway. A clay jug, woven baskets, ochre walls and a sunlit courtyard frame the quiet watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Ezekiel's attentive stillness imagines receiving the Lord's word on the date named in the verse. His appearance, clothing, room, scroll and daylight are artistic choices, not details supplied here. The rolled parchment suggests readiness to preserve the message; it is not the Lord's word made visible. God remains unseen, and the message that follows is not anticipated.
